## 3.1 Pre-processing Summary Counts of ICD Codes by Fungal Group

```{r}
#Libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

#SUMMARY TABLE: Make table of number of codes by main_group in each icd_version
table(icd_data$main_group, icd_data$icd_version)

#SUMMARY TABLE: Make table of number of codes by fungal_group in each icd_version
table(icd_data$fungal_group, icd_data$icd_version) 

```

## 3.2 Pre-processing Summary Table of ICD Code Counts by Main Group, Fungal Group, and ICD Version

```{r}
#SUMMARY TABLE - Formatted so ICD version is in the correct order for the frequency counts by main_group and fungal_group
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

#Create a reference list of which fungal_group belongs to which main_group
reference_main_fungal_groups <- icd_data %>%
  select(main_group, fungal_group) %>%
  distinct()
#Generate frequency table in a wide format
combined_icdcount_groups <- icd_data %>%
  group_by(fungal_group, icd_version) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = icd_version, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) %>%
  left_join(reference_main_fungal_groups, by = "fungal_group") %>%
  select(main_group, fungal_group, any_of(c("ICD-9", "ICD-10", "ICD-11"))) %>%
  arrange(main_group, fungal_group)

print(combined_icdcount_groups)

```

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(gt)

#Define the lists for categorization
diverse_list <- c("Dermatomycoses",  "General Mycoses")
taxon_list <- c("Aspergillus", "Blastomyces", "Candida", "Coccidioides", 
                "Cryptococcus", "Histoplasma", "Mucorales", "Paracoccidioides", "Sporothrix","Other Fungus-specific Mycoses")

#List of names to be italicized
italics_list <- c("Aspergillus", "Blastomyces", "Candida", "Coccidioides", 
                  "Cryptococcus", "Malassezia", "Histoplasma", "Histoplasma capsulatum", 
                  "Histoplasma duboisii", "Mucorales", "Emergomyces", 
                  "Geotrichum/Magnusiomyces", "Lacazia", "Penicillium/Talaromyces", 
                  "Pneumocystis", "Scedosporium", "Paracoccidioides", "Sporothrix")

#Update the data frame logic
final_table_data <- combined_icdcount_groups %>%
  mutate(mycoses_category = case_when(
    main_group %in% diverse_list ~ "Diverse Fungal Etiology",
    main_group %in% taxon_list ~ "Taxon-Specific",
    TRUE ~ main_group
  )) %>%
  #Organize columns in the requested order
  select(`Mycoses Category` = mycoses_category, 
         `Main Group` = main_group,
         `Fungal Group` = fungal_group, 
         any_of(c("ICD-9", "ICD-10", "ICD-11"))) %>%
  arrange(`Mycoses Category`, `Main Group`, `Fungal Group`)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(forcats)
library(gt)

#Level 1: Mycoses Category 
cat_counts <- icd_data %>%
  mutate(mycoses_category = ifelse(main_group %in% taxon_list, "Taxon-Specific", "Diverse Fungal Etiology")) %>%
  group_by(mycoses_category, icd_version) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = icd_version, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(label = mycoses_category, type = "1_header", sub_ref = "0")

#Level 2: Main Group
main_counts <- icd_data %>%
  mutate(mycoses_category = ifelse(main_group %in% taxon_list, "Taxon-Specific", "Diverse Fungal Etiology")) %>%
  group_by(mycoses_category, main_group, icd_version) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = icd_version, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(label = main_group, type = "2_main", sub_ref = main_group)

#Level 3: Fungal Group 
fungal_counts <- icd_data %>%
  mutate(mycoses_category = ifelse(main_group %in% taxon_list, "Taxon-Specific", "Diverse Fungal Etiology")) %>%
  group_by(mycoses_category, main_group, fungal_group, icd_version) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = icd_version, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(label = fungal_group, type = "3_sub", sub_ref = main_group)

#Combine and Sort
final_table_data <- bind_rows(cat_counts, main_counts, fungal_counts) %>%
  mutate(mycoses_category = fct_relevel(mycoses_category, "Taxon-Specific", "Diverse Fungal Etiology")) %>%
  arrange(mycoses_category, sub_ref, type)

#Build the Table and hide columns that assisted with architecture 
manuscript_table_final <- final_table_data %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_hide(columns = any_of(c("mycoses_category", "type", "sub_ref", "main_group", "fungal_group"))) %>%
  cols_move_to_end(columns = any_of(c("ICD-9", "ICD-10", "ICD-11"))) %>%
  cols_move_to_start(columns = label) %>% #Ensure the label is on the left
  cols_label(label = "Mycoses Code Classification") %>%
  sub_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "") %>% #Replace NAs/Missing with empty strings
  #Mycoses Category Formatting
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = "#aed2f5"), 
      cell_text(weight = "bold")
    ),
    locations = cells_body(rows = type == "1_header")
  ) %>%
  
  #Main Group Formatting
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = "#E9E9E9"),
      cell_text(weight = "bold")
    ),
    locations = cells_body(
      rows = type == "2_main"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  #Fungal Group Formatting
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(indent = px(20)),
    locations = cells_body(columns = label, rows = type == "3_sub")
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(style = "italic"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = label, 
      rows = label %in% italics_list
    )
  ) %>%
  
  #Table border formatting
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(sides = "top", color = "#BDBDBD", weight = px(1)),
    locations = cells_body(rows = type == "2_main")
  ) %>%
  
  #Text Formatting
  opt_table_font(font = list(google_font("Arial"), "sans-serif")) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(11),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
    table.border.top.color = "black",
    table.border.top.width = px(3),
    table.border.bottom.color = "black",
    table.border.bottom.width = px(3),
    data_row.padding = px(4)
  )

#Print and save tables as rtf and png
print(manuscript_table_final)
gtsave(manuscript_table_final, "C:/Users/mmvmk/Desktop/icd_r/outputs_tables/icd_hierarchical_final.rtf")
gtsave(manuscript_table_final, 
  filename = "C:/Users/mmvmk/Desktop/icd_r/outputs_tables/icd_hierarchical_final.png",
  vwidth = 1000,   
  vheight = 1200
)
message("Table file has been saved successfully!")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(forcats)
library(gt)

#Define the custom order for the Taxon-Specific section
taxon_order <- c("Aspergillus", "Blastomyces", "Candida", "Coccidioides", 
                 "Cryptococcus", "Histoplasma", "Mucorales", "Paracoccidioides", 
                 "Sporothrix", "Other Fungus-specific Mycoses")

#List of redundant fungal_groups to remove
redundant_fungal_groups <- c("Aspergillus", "Blastomyces", "Candida", "Coccidioides", 
                             "Cryptococcus", "Mucorales", "Paracoccidioides", "Sporothrix")

#Level 1: Mycoses Category
cat_counts <- icd_data %>%
  mutate(mycoses_category = ifelse(main_group %in% taxon_list, "Taxon-Specific", "Diverse Fungal Etiology")) %>%
  group_by(mycoses_category, icd_version) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = icd_version, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(label = mycoses_category, type = "1_header", sub_ref = "0")

#Level 2: Main Group
main_counts <- icd_data %>%
  mutate(mycoses_category = ifelse(main_group %in% taxon_list, "Taxon-Specific", "Diverse Fungal Etiology")) %>%
  group_by(mycoses_category, main_group, icd_version) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = icd_version, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(label = main_group, type = "2_main", sub_ref = main_group)

#Level 3: Fungal Group
fungal_counts <- icd_data %>%
  mutate(mycoses_category = ifelse(main_group %in% taxon_list, "Taxon-Specific", "Diverse Fungal Etiology")) %>%
  filter(!fungal_group %in% redundant_fungal_groups) %>% 
  group_by(mycoses_category, main_group, fungal_group, icd_version) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = icd_version, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(label = fungal_group, type = "3_sub", sub_ref = main_group)

#Combine and sort using my preferred order
final_table_data <- bind_rows(cat_counts, main_counts, fungal_counts) %>%
  mutate(
    mycoses_category = fct_relevel(mycoses_category, "Taxon-Specific", "Diverse Fungal Etiology"),
    sub_ref = factor(sub_ref, levels = c("0", taxon_order, setdiff(unique(sub_ref), c("0", taxon_order))))
  ) %>%
  arrange(mycoses_category, sub_ref, type)

#Build the table
manuscript_table_final <- final_table_data %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_hide(columns = any_of(c("mycoses_category", "type", "sub_ref", "main_group", "fungal_group"))) %>%
  cols_move_to_end(columns = any_of(c("ICD-9", "ICD-10", "ICD-11"))) %>%
  cols_move_to_start(columns = label) %>%
  cols_label(label = "Mycoses Classification") %>%
  sub_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "") %>%
  
  #Format Mycoses Category Rows
  tab_style(
    style = list(cell_fill(color = "#aed2f5"), cell_text(weight = "bold")),
    locations = cells_body(rows = type == "1_header")
  ) %>%
  
  #Format Main Group Rows
  tab_style(
    style = list(cell_fill(color = "#E9E9E9"), style = cell_text(indent = px(20)), cell_text(weight = "bold")),
    locations = cells_body(rows = type == "2_main")
  ) %>%
  
  #Format Fungal Group Rows
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(indent = px(40)),
    locations = cells_body(columns = label, rows = type == "3_sub")
  ) %>%
  
  #Add italic format for scientific names that I specified earlier
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(style = "italic"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = label, rows = label %in% italics_list)
  ) %>%
  
  #Format the table border and font
  opt_table_font(font = list(google_font("Arial"), "sans-serif")) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(11),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
    table.border.top.color = "black",
    table.border.top.width = px(3),
    table.border.bottom.color = "black",
    table.border.bottom.width = px(3)
  )

#Save tables as a rtf and png
gtsave(manuscript_table_final, "C:/Users/mmvmk/Desktop/icd_r/outputs_tables/icd_hierarchical_filtered.rtf")
gtsave(manuscript_table_final, "C:/Users/mmvmk/Desktop/icd_r/outputs_tables/icd_hierarchical_filtered.png", vwidth = 1200)
message("Table has been saved successfully!")
```

### 4.1.3 Remove Stop Words, Whitespace, and Alphabetize Words in Text Strings

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
###Remove stop words from new_description 
####Create list of stop words to be removed from new_description
icd_stop_words <- tibble(word = c("and", "or", "of", "from", "with","to", "by", "in", "due", "involving", "associated", "infection",
                                  "finding", "certain", "forms","conditions", "induced", "multiple", "toxic", "effect", "area",
                                  "attributable", "the", "encounter","involvement", "without", "manifestation", "mention", "tract"))

####Create a regex pattern with word boundaries and the OR operator 
pattern <- paste0("\\b(", paste(icd_stop_words$word, collapse = "|"), ")\\b")

####Remove all specified words
clean_icd_data$final_description <- gsub(pattern, "", clean_icd_data$new_description)

####Fix spacing
clean_icd_data$final_description <- str_squish(clean_icd_data$final_description)

#Alphabetize words in the string for our new_description with Words are separated by single whitespace so we can sort them
sort_words <- function(phrase) {sapply(phrase, function(x) {if (is.na(x) | x == "") return(x)
    words <- unlist(strsplit(x, "\\s+")) 
    paste(sort(words), collapse = " ")})}

####Alphabetize words so order doesn't matter for matching
clean_icd_data$final_description <- sort_words(clean_icd_data$final_description)

```

# 5.0 Define Match Pairs and Generate Match Score Calculation

```{r}
#MATCH SCORING
##Create a new data frame that calculates match scores
###Create a list of columns to compare
match_categories <- c("final_description", "fungal_group", "fungal_order", "fungal_genus", "fungal_species", "cat_internal_external",
                       "cat_disease_type", "organ_system", "bodysite")

###Create all unique pairs of rows for comparison
comparison_pairs <- clean_icd_data %>%
  mutate(key = 1) %>%
  full_join (clean_icd_data %>% mutate(key = 1), by = "key", suffix = c("_p1", "_p2"), relationship="many-to-many") %>%
  select(-key) %>%
  filter(code_p1 != code_p2 | icd_version_p1 != icd_version_p2 | fungal_group_p1 != fungal_group_p2 | final_description_p1 != final_description_p2) %>%
  unique()

###Iterate through each comparison column to create the 0/1 match columns for columns in match_categories
for (col in match_categories) { 
  col_p1 <- paste0(col, "_p1") 
  col_p2 <- paste0(col, "_p2") 
  new_col_name <- paste0("match_", col) 
  comparison_pairs <- comparison_pairs %>%
  mutate(!!new_col_name := ifelse(!!sym(col_p1)==!!sym(col_p2), 1, 0))}

###Calculate the cumulative match score
comparison_pairs <- comparison_pairs %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(cumulative_match_score = sum(c_across(starts_with("match_"))), .before = 1) %>%
  ungroup()

###Select and rename columns to match desired output
match_score <- comparison_pairs %>%
  select(
    'partner1_icd_code'= code_p1,
    'partner1_icd_definition' = icd_definition_p1,
    'partner1_icd_version' = icd_version_p1,
    'partner1_fungal_group'= fungal_group_p1,
    'partner1_main_group' = main_group_p1,
    'partner1_group_order' = group_order_p1,
    'partner1_final_description' = final_description_p1,
    'partner2_icd_code' = code_p2,
    'partner2_icd_definition' = icd_definition_p2,
    'partner2_icd_version' = icd_version_p2,
    'partner2_fungal_group' = fungal_group_p2,
    'partner2_main_group' = main_group_p2,
    'partner2_group_order' = group_order_p2,
    'partner2_final_description' = final_description_p2,
    'match_fungal_group',
    'match_fungal_order',
    'match_fungal_genus',
    'match_fungal_species',
    'match_final_description',
    'match_cat_internal_external',
    'match_cat_disease_type',
    'match_organ_system',
    'match_bodysite',
    'cumulative_match_score')

#Create a new variable that creates a similarity score for partial matches for the final_description
library(stringdist)
match_score <- match_score %>%
  mutate(match_fuzzy_description = 1 - stringdist(partner1_final_description, partner2_final_description, method = "jaccard", q = 2))

###Modify match_fungal_group and match_description and match_final_description to have higher weights if they match
match_score$match_fungal_group <- ifelse(match_score$match_fungal_group == 1, match_score$match_fungal_group + 24, match_score$match_fungal_group)
match_score$match_final_description <- ifelse(match_score$match_final_description == 1, match_score$match_final_description + 19, match_score$match_final_description)
match_score$match_organ_system <- ifelse(match_score$match_organ_system == 1, match_score$match_organ_system + 9, match_score$match_organ_system)
match_score$match_bodysite <- ifelse(match_score$match_bodysite ==1, match_score$match_bodysite + 14, match_score$match_bodysite)
match_score$match_fungal_species <- ifelse(match_score$match_fungal_species == 1, match_score$match_fungal_species + 1, match_score$match_fungal_species)
match_score$match_cat_disease_type <- ifelse(match_score$match_cat_disease_type ==1, match_score$match_cat_disease_type +9, match_score$match_cat_disease_type)
match_score$match_fuzzy_description <- ifelse(match_score$match_fuzzy_description >= 0.7, match_score$match_fuzzy_description + 14, match_score$match_fuzzy_description)

###Now overwrite the original cumulative_match_score so that it now adds in the updated weighted values
match_score <- match_score %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(cumulative_match_score = sum (c_across(starts_with("match_")))) %>%
  ungroup()

###Calculate the maximum value for the cumulative_match_score
max_score <- max(match_score$cumulative_match_score)

###Create a new column/variable to normalize the cumulative_match_score to be between 
match_score$normalized_score <- match_score$cumulative_match_score/max_score
###Create a new column/variable that calculates the distance or difference between the max_score and the match_score
match_score$score_distance <-max_score - match_score$cumulative_match_score 

###Check column names
colnames(match_score)

str(match_score)

##Save match_score results
write.csv(match_score, "C:/Users/mmvmk/Desktop/icd_r/outputs_tables/Fungal_ICD_MatchScore_Results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
message("Excel file has been created successfully!")
```

## 5.3 Best Match for Each Main Group - Function

```{r}
#CREATE INDIVIDUAL TABLES BY MAIN GROUP
generate_match_summary <- function(main_group_name, match_score_data) {
  match_score_data %>%
    #Filter for source codes belonging to target group
    filter(partner1_main_group == main_group_name) %>%
    #Group by the specific source code
    group_by(partner1_icd_code, partner1_icd_definition, partner1_icd_version) %>%
    #Find the top match score(s) for each code
    slice_max(order_by = cumulative_match_score, n = 1, with_ties = TRUE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(
      partner1_icd_code, 
      partner1_icd_definition, 
      partner1_icd_version,
      best_match_code = partner2_icd_code,
      best_match_definition = partner2_icd_definition,
      best_match_version = partner2_icd_version,
      best_match_main_group = partner2_main_group, 
      score = cumulative_match_score
    ) %>%
    arrange(partner1_icd_version, partner1_icd_code)}

```

# 6.0 Best Match Selection for Sankey Network Mapping (Standard, Skip-link, and Orphans)

```{r}
#CREATE REFERENCES FOR REUSABLE CODE TO GENERATE SANKEY DIAGRAMS/NETWORKS
##Define ICD Versions for future Sankey diagram/network creation
VERSION_P1 <- "ICD-9"
VERSION_P2 <- "ICD-10"
VERSION_P3 <- "ICD-11"

##Create a reference table for the definitions and versions
definition_version_map <- clean_icd_data %>% 
  select(icd_definition, icd_version) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  rename(name = icd_definition, node_group = icd_version)

#CREATE BEST MATCH FUNCTION FOR SANKEY DIAGRAMS
##Filter best matches to ensure fungal groups match and pick highest score with ties only if they meet the 45 point cutoff
allicd_bestmatch <- function(match_score, code_origin, code_destination) {
  match_score %>%
    arrange(partner1_group_order, partner2_group_order) %>%
    filter(partner1_icd_version == code_origin, 
           partner2_icd_version == code_destination) %>%
    filter(partner1_fungal_group == partner2_fungal_group) %>% #Only allow matches within the same fungal_group
    filter(cumulative_match_score >= 45) %>% #Apply minimum cutoff threshold (e.g., must be at least 45% match)
    group_by(partner1_icd_definition) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = cumulative_match_score, n = 1, with_ties = TRUE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(
      partner1_icd_definition,
      partner2_icd_definition,
      cumulative_match_score,
      partner1_group_order) %>%
    arrange(partner1_group_order) %>%
    rename(
      source_def = partner1_icd_definition,
      target_def = partner2_icd_definition,
      value = cumulative_match_score,
      group = partner1_group_order)}


#CREATE SUBSET OF UNIQUE MATCHES THAT DO NOT MEET THE 45% threshold 
##Helper function to capture orphans and assign a small constant value so the line is visible in Sankey
get_unique_links <- function(original_data, links_df, version, label) {
  orphans <- original_data %>%
    filter(icd_version == version) %>%
    anti_join(links_df, by = c("icd_definition" = "source_def")) %>%
    select(source_def = icd_definition, group = group_order) %>%
    mutate(
      target_def = paste0("Unique to ", version),
      value = 10 )
  return(orphans)}

#MAKE LINK REFERENCES FOR FORWARD MAPPING FOR SANKEY NETWORK CREATION
##Make links reference for sankey networks
links_icd910  <- allicd_bestmatch(match_score, VERSION_P1, VERSION_P2)
links_icd1011 <- allicd_bestmatch(match_score, VERSION_P2, VERSION_P3)
links_icd911  <- allicd_bestmatch(match_score, VERSION_P1, VERSION_P3)

##Make links for ICD-9 to ICD-11 only if they meet the specific cutoff
links_9_11_to_include <- links_icd911 %>% 
  left_join(links_icd910 %>% select(source_def, val_910 = value), by = "source_def") %>% 
  filter(is.na(val_910) | value > (val_910 + 10)) %>%  
  select(-val_910)

##Filter to capture the unique or Orphan Nodes and find ICD-9 codes that didn't make it into 9->10 OR 9->11 links due to not meeting the cutoff
orphans_icd9 <- clean_icd_data %>%
  filter(icd_version == VERSION_P1) %>% 
  anti_join(bind_rows(links_icd910, links_9_11_to_include), by = c("icd_definition" = "source_def")) %>%
  select(source_def = icd_definition, group = group_order) %>%
  mutate(target_def = paste0("Unique to ", VERSION_P1), value = 5)

##Filter to capture the unique or Orphan Nodes and find ICD-10 codes that didn't make it into 10->11 links
orphans_icd10 <- clean_icd_data %>%
  filter(icd_version == VERSION_P2) %>% # Removed main_group_name filter
  anti_join(links_icd1011, by = c("icd_definition" = "source_def")) %>%
  select(source_def = icd_definition, group = group_order) %>%
  mutate(target_def = paste0("Unique to ", VERSION_P2), value = 5)

##Combine ALL links -- Standard, Skip, and Orphan links and create a backup output in case there is any with no links
links_fwd <- bind_rows(links_icd910, links_icd1011, links_9_11_to_include, orphans_icd9, orphans_icd10)
if(nrow(links_fwd) == 0) {stop(paste("No links found for group:", main_group_name))}

##For links that do not have any match that meets the cutoff, create node map to include the "Unique" categories
unique_labels <- data.frame(
  name = c(paste0("Unique to ", VERSION_P1), paste0("Unique to ", VERSION_P2)),
  node_group = c("Unique", "Unique"))

definition_version_map <- bind_rows(definition_version_map, unique_labels) %>% distinct()
```

# 7.0 Summary Best Match Sankey Networks

## 7.1 Forward Best Matches
```{r}
########################################################################################################
#CREATE FORWARD SUMMARY SANKEY (ICD-9 -> ICD-10 -> ICD-11)
########################################################################################################
##Calculate version-specific labels and add the version prefix here to force separate columns in the Sankey
group_lookup <- clean_icd_data %>%
  group_by(icd_version, group_order, main_group) %>%
  summarise(n = n_distinct(icd_definition), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(label_with_count = paste0(icd_version, ": ", main_group, " (n=", n, ")"))

##Prepare the links with reliable version detection and create the dictionary OUTSIDE of mutate
version_dict <- clean_icd_data %>%
  select(icd_definition, icd_version) %>%
  distinct()

##Combine the links and define "Unique to" nodes and assign labels
summary_links <- links_fwd %>%
  left_join(version_dict, by = c("source_def" = "icd_definition")) %>%
  rename(src_v = icd_version) %>%
  left_join(version_dict, by = c("target_def" = "icd_definition")) %>%
  rename(tgt_v = icd_version) %>%
  mutate(
    src_v = case_when(
      !is.na(src_v) ~ src_v,
      grepl("ICD-9", source_def) ~ VERSION_P1,
      grepl("ICD-10", source_def) ~ VERSION_P2,
      TRUE ~ VERSION_P1),
    tgt_v = case_when(
      !is.na(tgt_v) ~ tgt_v,
      grepl("ICD-10", target_def) ~ VERSION_P2,
      grepl("ICD-11", target_def) ~ VERSION_P3,
      TRUE ~ VERSION_P2),
    src_label = ifelse(grepl("Unique", source_def), source_def, 
                       group_lookup$label_with_count[match(paste0(src_v, group), 
                                                           paste0(group_lookup$icd_version, group_lookup$group_order))]),
    tgt_label = ifelse(grepl("Unique", target_def), target_def, 
                       group_lookup$label_with_count[match(paste0(tgt_v, group), 
                                                           paste0(group_lookup$icd_version, group_lookup$group_order))])) %>%
  group_by(src_label, tgt_label) %>%
  summarise(value = n(), .groups = 'drop')

##Make the icd_version prefix invisible
summary_links <- summary_links %>%
  mutate(link_group = sub("^ICD-[0-9]+: ", "", src_label))

##Define Nodes for Sankey Network
nodes_summary <- data.frame(name = unique(c(summary_links$src_label, summary_links$tgt_label)))

##Create levels for each ICD version so we can control placement within the Sankey Network
nodes_summary <- nodes_summary %>%
  mutate(display_name = sub("^ICD-[0-9]+: ", "", name)) %>% # Removes the prefix
  mutate(level = case_when(
    grepl("ICD-9", name) ~ 0,
    grepl("ICD-10", name) ~ 1,
    grepl("ICD-11", name) ~ 2,
    TRUE ~ 1))

summary_links$IDsource <- match(summary_links$src_label, nodes_summary$name) - 1
summary_links$IDtarget <- match(summary_links$tgt_label, nodes_summary$name) - 1

##Make Sankey Network with labels - This Sankey has the node colored by ICD version and all links are grey.
library(networkD3)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(htmltools)

sn_summary <- sankeyNetwork(Links = summary_links, Nodes = nodes_summary,
                            Source = "IDsource", Target = "IDtarget", 
                            Value = "value", 
                            NodeID = "display_name",
                            LinkGroup = "link_group", 
                            nodePadding = 20,
                            height = 600, width = 1100,
                            margin = list(left = 1, right = 1),
                            fontSize = 16, nodeWidth = 20, iterations = 0, sinksRight = FALSE)
sn_summary <- onRender(
  sn_summary,
  '
  function(el, x) {
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node text")
      .style("font-family", "Arial, sans-serif")
      .style("font-size", "16px")
      .style("paint-order", "stroke")     
      .style("stroke", "#ffffff")         
      .style("stroke-width", "2px")       
      .style("stroke-linejoin", "round")  
      .style("fill", "#000000")
      // NEW LOGIC: Modify text display based on column position
      .text(function(d) {
         // d.x is the horizontal position. 
         // For a 3-column Sankey: Column 0 (Left), Column 1 (Mid), Column 2 (Right)
         // If we are NOT in the first column (ICD-9), hide the group name
         if (d.x > 100) { 
            // This regex finds the (n=...) part and keeps only that
            var match = d.name.match(/\\(n=[0-9]+\\)/);
            return match ? match[0] : d.name;
         }
         return d.name; // Keep ICD-9 labels as they are
      });
  }
  '
)

browsable(
  tagList(
    tags$h2("Fungal ICD Mapping Network Summary (Forward)", 
            style="text-align:left; font-family:Arial, sans-serif;"),
    tags$div(style="display: flex; justify-content: space-around; font-weight: bold; font-family:Arial, sans-serif; margin-bottom: 10px; width: 750px; margin: auto;",
      tags$div("ICD-9", style="width: 33%; text-align: left;"), tags$div("ICD-10", style="width: 33%; text-align: center;"), tags$div("ICD-11", style="width: 33%; text-align: right;")
    ),
    sn_summary
  )
)

#Save the Sankey as a temporary HTML file
library(htmlwidgets)
library(webshot2)
saveWidget(sn_summary, "temp_sankey.html", selfcontained = TRUE)

#Capture the HTML as a high-res PNG
webshot("temp_sankey.html", 
        file = "C:/Users/mmvmk/Desktop/icd_r/outputs_sankeys/ForwardSummarySankey.png", 
        delay = 2,      
        zoom = 3,       
        vwidth = 1100,  
        vheight = 600)

```

# 8.0 Fungal Group Best Match Sankey Networks
## 8.1 Aspergillus
### 8.1.1 Forward Best Matches
```{r}
########################################################################################################
#CREATE INDIVIDUAL DETAILED SANKEY NETWORK FOR EACH MAIN GROUP - ASPERGILLUS #1 - Forward
########################################################################################################
##Specify main_group
TARGET_GROUP <- "Aspergillus"

##Get links for this group only
group_match_score <- match_score %>%
  filter(partner1_main_group == TARGET_GROUP & partner2_main_group == TARGET_GROUP)

l_9_10  <- allicd_bestmatch(group_match_score, VERSION_P1, VERSION_P2)
l_10_11 <- allicd_bestmatch(group_match_score, VERSION_P2, VERSION_P3)
l_9_11  <- allicd_bestmatch(group_match_score, VERSION_P1, VERSION_P3)

##Filter skip links (9 to 11) to avoid clutter
l_9_11_filtered <- l_9_11 %>% 
  left_join(l_9_10 %>% select(source_def, val_910 = value), by = "source_def") %>% 
  filter(is.na(val_910) | value > (val_910 + 10)) %>% select(-val_910)

##Capture Orphans
orph_9 <- clean_icd_data %>%
  filter(icd_version == VERSION_P1, main_group == TARGET_GROUP) %>% 
  anti_join(bind_rows(l_9_10, l_9_11_filtered), by = c("icd_definition" = "source_def")) %>%
  select(source_def = icd_definition) %>%
  mutate(target_def = paste0("Unique to ", VERSION_P1), value = 1)

orph_10 <- clean_icd_data %>%
  filter(icd_version == VERSION_P2, main_group == TARGET_GROUP) %>% 
  anti_join(l_10_11, by = c("icd_definition" = "source_def")) %>%
  select(source_def = icd_definition) %>%
  mutate(target_def = paste0("Unique to ", VERSION_P2), value = 1)

##Combine links
raw_links <- bind_rows(l_9_10, l_10_11, l_9_11_filtered, orph_9, orph_10)

##Build the Version Dictionary
version_dict <- clean_icd_data %>%
  filter(main_group == TARGET_GROUP) %>%
  select(icd_definition, icd_version) %>%
  distinct()

##Edit links so they contain icd_version as a prefix to assist with anchoring nodes
processed_links <- raw_links %>%
  left_join(version_dict, by = c("source_def" = "icd_definition")) %>%
  rename(src_v = icd_version) %>%
  left_join(version_dict, by = c("target_def" = "icd_definition")) %>%
  rename(tgt_v = icd_version) %>%
  mutate(
    #Ensure every source/target has a version assigned for column control
    src_v = case_when(
      !is.na(src_v) ~ src_v,
      grepl("ICD-9", source_def) ~ VERSION_P1,
      TRUE ~ VERSION_P1),
    tgt_v = case_when(
      !is.na(tgt_v) ~ tgt_v,
      grepl(VERSION_P2, target_def) ~ VERSION_P2,
      grepl(VERSION_P3, target_def) ~ VERSION_P3,
      #If it's unique to 9, it sits in the ICD-10 column
      grepl(paste0("Unique to ", VERSION_P1), target_def) ~ VERSION_P2,
      #If it's unique to 10, it sits in the ICD-11 column
      grepl(paste0("Unique to ", VERSION_P2), target_def) ~ VERSION_P3,
      TRUE ~ tgt_v
    ),
    #Create the final labels that will appear in the Sankey
    src_label = ifelse(grepl("Unique", source_def), source_def, paste0(src_v, ": ", source_def)),
    tgt_label = ifelse(grepl("Unique", target_def), target_def, paste0(tgt_v, ": ", target_def))
  ) %>%
  mutate(value = 1) 

#Define Nodes
nodes_group <- data.frame(name = unique(c(processed_links$src_label, processed_links$tgt_label)))

#Assign explicit levels (0, 1, 2) to force the columns for nodes
nodes_group <- nodes_group %>%
  mutate(level = case_when(
    grepl(VERSION_P1, name) ~ 0,
    grepl(VERSION_P2, name) ~ 1,
    grepl(VERSION_P3, name) ~ 2,
    TRUE ~ 1
  )) %>%
  #Define levels for nodes so I can add on specific colors for each icd_version column
  mutate(node_group = case_when(
    grepl("Unique", name) ~ "Unique",
    level == 0 ~ "ICD9",
    level == 1 ~ "ICD10",
    level == 2 ~ "ICD11",
    TRUE ~ "Unique"
  ))

#Map the source and target nodes
processed_links$IDsource <- match(processed_links$src_label, nodes_group$name) - 1
processed_links$IDtarget <- match(processed_links$tgt_label, nodes_group$name) - 1

#Specify colors
my_color <- 'd3.scaleOrdinal() 
             .domain(["ICD9", "ICD10", "ICD11", "Unique"]) 
             .range(["#66a9d9", "#085e9c", "#d98f21", "#e03abf"])'
#Create Sankey Network
sn_group <- sankeyNetwork(
  Links = as.data.frame(processed_links), 
  Nodes = as.data.frame(nodes_group),
  Source = "IDsource", Target = "IDtarget", 
  Value = "value", NodeID = "name", 
  NodeGroup = "node_group", colourScale = my_color,
  nodePadding = 10, fontSize = 14, nodeWidth = 30, 
  iterations = 0, sinksRight = TRUE,
  height = 217, width = 1500,
  margin = list(left = 475, right = 1)
)

#Format Text and add Headers and Title (Bold and Left-Align Column 0)
sn_group <- onRender(
  sn_group,
  'function(el, x) {
    d3.select(el).select("svg").style("overflow", "visible");
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node text")
      .style("font-weight", "bold")
      .style("font-family", "Arial, sans-serif")
      .style("font-size", "14px")
      .attr("x", 35) 
      .attr("text-anchor", "start").text(function(d) { 
          return d.name.replace(/ICD-(9|10|11): /g, ""); 
      });}  ')

browsable(
  tagList(
    tags$h2(paste("Forward Mapping:", TARGET_GROUP), 
            style="text-align:center; font-family:sans-serif; color:#333;"),
    tags$div(
      style="display: flex; width: 1500px; margin: auto; font-weight: bold; font-family:sans-serif; text-align: center;",
      tags$div(VERSION_P1, style="flex: 1;"),
      tags$div(VERSION_P2, style="flex: 1;"),
      tags$div(VERSION_P3, style="flex: 1;")
    ),
    tags$div(sn_group, style="display: flex; justify-content: center;")
  )
)


#Save the Sankey as a temporary HTML file
library(htmlwidgets)
library(webshot2)
saveWidget(sn_group, "temp_sankey.html", selfcontained = TRUE)

#Capture the HTML as a high-res PNG
webshot("temp_sankey.html", 
        file = "C:/Users/mmvmk/Desktop/icd_r/outputs_sankeys/Aspergillus_ForwardSankey.png", 
        delay = 2,      
        zoom = 3,       
        vwidth = 1500,  
        vheight = 800)
```

### 8.1.2 Reverse Best Matches

```{r}
#######################################################################################################
# CREATE INDIVIDUAL DETAILED SANKEY NETWORK FOR EACH MAIN GROUP - ASPERGILLUS (REVERSE)
#######################################################################################################
##Specify main_group
TARGET_GROUP <- "Aspergillus"

##Get links for this group only
group_match_score <- match_score %>%
  filter(partner1_main_group == TARGET_GROUP & partner2_main_group == TARGET_GROUP)

#REVERSE Logic: source is the newer version, target is the older version
l_11_10 <- allicd_bestmatch(group_match_score, VERSION_P3, VERSION_P2)
l_10_9  <- allicd_bestmatch(group_match_score, VERSION_P2, VERSION_P1)
l_11_9  <- allicd_bestmatch(group_match_score, VERSION_P3, VERSION_P1)

##Filter skip links (11 to 9) to avoid clutter
l_11_9_filtered <- l_11_9 %>% 
  left_join(l_11_10 %>% select(source_def, val_1110 = value), by = "source_def") %>% 
  filter(is.na(val_1110) | value > (val_1110 + 10)) %>% select(-val_1110)

##Capture Orphans & Ghosts (Phantom Strategy - Reverse)
#Standard 11 to 10 Links
l_11_10_labeled <- l_11_10 %>%
  mutate(src_label = paste0(VERSION_P3, ": ", source_def),
         tgt_label = paste0(VERSION_P2, ": ", target_def))

#Standard 10 to 9 Links
l_10_9_labeled <- l_10_9 %>%
  mutate(src_label = paste0(VERSION_P2, ": ", source_def),
         tgt_label = paste0(VERSION_P1, ": ", target_def))

#Skip-Links (11 to Ghost to 9)
l_11_9_ghosts <- l_11_9_filtered %>%
  mutate(ghost_node = paste0("Ghost: ", source_def))

links_11_to_ghost <- l_11_9_ghosts %>%
  mutate(src_label = paste0(VERSION_P3, ": ", source_def),
         tgt_label = ghost_node) 

links_ghost_to_9 <- l_11_9_ghosts %>%
  mutate(src_label = ghost_node, 
         tgt_label = paste0(VERSION_P1, ": ", target_def))

#Orphans & Stretch Structural Links (Directional: 11 -> 10 column -> 9 column)
orph_11_to_10 <- clean_icd_data %>%
  filter(icd_version == VERSION_P3, main_group == TARGET_GROUP) %>% 
  anti_join(bind_rows(l_11_10, l_11_9_filtered), by = c("icd_definition" = "source_def")) %>%
  select(source_def = icd_definition) %>%
  mutate(target_def = paste0(VERSION_P3, " Only"), value = 1) %>%
  mutate(src_label = paste0(VERSION_P3, ": ", source_def),
         tgt_label = target_def)

orph_11_stretch <- orph_11_to_10 %>%
  select(source_def = target_def) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(target_def = paste0(VERSION_P3, " Only (Final)"), value = 1) %>%
  mutate(src_label = source_def, 
         tgt_label = target_def)

orph_10_to_9 <- clean_icd_data %>%
  filter(icd_version == VERSION_P2, main_group == TARGET_GROUP) %>% 
  anti_join(l_10_9, by = c("icd_definition" = "source_def")) %>%
  select(source_def = icd_definition) %>%
  mutate(target_def = paste0(VERSION_P2, " Only"), value = 1) %>%
  mutate(src_label = paste0(VERSION_P2, ": ", source_def),
         tgt_label = target_def)

##Combine all links
processed_links <- bind_rows(
  l_11_10_labeled, l_10_9_labeled, 
  links_11_to_ghost, links_ghost_to_9, 
  orph_11_to_10, orph_11_stretch, orph_10_to_9
) %>%
  mutate(value = 1)

##Define Nodes with Explicit Level Control
nodes_group <- data.frame(name = unique(c(processed_links$src_label, processed_links$tgt_label)))

nodes_group <- nodes_group %>%
  mutate(name_str = as.character(name)) %>% 
  mutate(level = case_when(
    # Column 0: ICD-11
    str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P3) ~ 0,
    
    # Column 1: ICD-10, Ghosts, and Column 1 Orphans
    str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P2) | str_detect(name_str, "Ghost") | 
      (str_detect(name_str, "Only") & str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P3)) ~ 1,
    
    # Column 2: ICD-9, Final Bridges, and Column 2 Orphans
    str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P1) | str_detect(name_str, "Final") |
      (str_detect(name_str, "Only") & str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P2)) ~ 2,
    
    TRUE ~ 1
  )) %>%
  mutate(node_group = case_when(
    str_detect(name_str, "Ghost|Final") ~ "hide",
    str_detect(name_str, "Only")  ~ "Unique",
    level == 0 ~ "ICD11",
    level == 1 ~ "ICD10",
    level == 2 ~ "ICD9",
    TRUE ~ "Unique"
  ))

##Map IDs
processed_links$IDsource <- match(processed_links$src_label, nodes_group$name) - 1
processed_links$IDtarget <- match(processed_links$tgt_label, nodes_group$name) - 1

##Colors (Updated Domain for Reverse Order)
my_color_rev <- 'd3.scaleOrdinal() 
                 .domain(["ICD11", "ICD10", "ICD9", "Unique", "hide"]) 
                 .range(["#d98f21", "#085e9c", "#66a9d9", "#e03abf", "#cccccc"])'

##Create Sankey
sn_group <- sankeyNetwork(
  Links = as.data.frame(processed_links), Nodes = as.data.frame(nodes_group),
  Source = "IDsource", Target = "IDtarget", Value = "value", NodeID = "name",
  NodeGroup = "node_group", colourScale = my_color_rev,
  nodePadding = 10, fontSize = 14, nodeWidth = 30, iterations = 0,
  sinksRight = TRUE, height = 550, width = 1500, margin = list(left = 475, right = 1)
)

##JavaScript Formatting (Includes font style and phantom logic)
sn_group <- onRender(
  sn_group,
  'function(el, x) {
    d3.select(el).select("svg").style("overflow", "visible");
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node text")
      .style("font-weight", "bold")
      .style("font-family", "Arial, sans-serif")
      .style("font-size", "14px")
      .attr("x", 35).attr("text-anchor", "start")
      .text(function(d) { 
          // First removes the version prefixes, then swaps the specific label
          return d.name.replace(/ICD-(9|10|11): /g, "")
                       .replace("ICD-10 Only", "Unique to ICD-10 and ICD-11 Only"); 
      });

    // Hide Final nodes
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node")
      .filter(function(d) { return d.name.indexOf("Final") > -1; })
      .style("opacity", 0).style("display", "none");

    // Camouflage Ghosts (#cccccc)
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node rect")
      .filter(function(d) { return d.name.indexOf("Ghost") > -1; })
      .style("fill", "#cccccc").style("fill-opacity", 1).style("stroke-width", 0);

    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node text")
      .filter(function(d) { return d.name.indexOf("Ghost") > -1; })
      .style("display", "none");

    // Hide Structural Stretch Links
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".link")
      .filter(function(d) { 
        var targetName = typeof d.target === "object" ? d.target.name : x.nodes[d.target].name;
        return targetName.indexOf("Final") > -1; 
      })
      .style("stroke-opacity", 0).style("opacity", 0).style("pointer-events", "none");
  }'
)

#Final Output (Headers Swapped)
browsable(
  tagList(
    tags$h2(paste("Reverse Mapping :", TARGET_GROUP), 
            style="text-align:center; font-family:Arial, sans-serif; color:#333;"),
    tags$div(
      style="display: flex; width: 1500px; margin: auto; font-weight: bold; font-family:Arial, sans-serif; text-align: center;",
      tags$div(VERSION_P3, style="flex: 1;"),
      tags$div(VERSION_P2, style="flex: 1;"),
      tags$div(VERSION_P1, style="flex: 1;")
    ),
    tags$div(sn_group, style="display: flex; justify-content: center;")
  )
)


#Save the Sankey as a temporary HTML file
library(htmlwidgets)
library(webshot2)
saveWidget(sn_group, "temp_sankey.html", selfcontained = TRUE)

#Capture the HTML as a high-res PNG
webshot("temp_sankey.html", 
        file = "C:/Users/mmvmk/Desktop/icd_r/outputs_sankeys/Aspergillus_ReverseSankey.png", 
        delay = 2,      
        zoom = 3,       
        vwidth = 1500,  
        vheight = 800)
```

```{r}
         tgt_label = paste0(VERSION_P2, ": ", target_def))

#Standard 10 to 9 Links
l_10_9_labeled <- l_10_9 %>%
  mutate(src_label = paste0(VERSION_P2, ": ", source_def),
         tgt_label = paste0(VERSION_P1, ": ", target_def))

#Skip-Links (11 to Ghost to 9)
l_11_9_ghosts <- l_11_9_filtered %>%
  mutate(ghost_node = paste0("Ghost: ", source_def))

links_11_to_ghost <- l_11_9_ghosts %>%
  mutate(src_label = paste0(VERSION_P3, ": ", source_def),
         tgt_label = ghost_node) 

links_ghost_to_9 <- l_11_9_ghosts %>%
  mutate(src_label = ghost_node, 
         tgt_label = paste0(VERSION_P1, ": ", target_def))

#Orphans & Stretch Structural Links (Directional: 11 -> 10 column -> 9 column)
orph_11_to_10 <- clean_icd_data %>%
  filter(icd_version == VERSION_P3, main_group == TARGET_GROUP) %>% 
  anti_join(bind_rows(l_11_10, l_11_9_filtered), by = c("icd_definition" = "source_def")) %>%
  select(source_def = icd_definition) %>%
  mutate(target_def = paste0(VERSION_P3, " Only"), value = 1) %>%
  mutate(src_label = paste0(VERSION_P3, ": ", source_def),
         tgt_label = target_def)

orph_11_stretch <- orph_11_to_10 %>%
  select(source_def = target_def) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(target_def = paste0(VERSION_P3, " Only (Final)"), value = 1) %>%
  mutate(src_label = source_def, 
         tgt_label = target_def)

orph_10_to_9 <- clean_icd_data %>%
  filter(icd_version == VERSION_P2, main_group == TARGET_GROUP) %>% 
  anti_join(l_10_9, by = c("icd_definition" = "source_def")) %>%
  select(source_def = icd_definition) %>%
  mutate(target_def = paste0(VERSION_P2, " Only"), value = 1) %>%
  mutate(src_label = paste0(VERSION_P2, ": ", source_def),
         tgt_label = target_def)

##Combine all links
processed_links <- bind_rows(
  l_11_10_labeled, l_10_9_labeled, 
  links_11_to_ghost, links_ghost_to_9, 
  orph_11_to_10, orph_11_stretch, orph_10_to_9
) %>%
  mutate(value = 1)

##Define Nodes with Explicit Level Control
nodes_group <- data.frame(name = unique(c(processed_links$src_label, processed_links$tgt_label)))

nodes_group <- nodes_group %>%
  mutate(name_str = as.character(name)) %>% 
  mutate(level = case_when(
    # Column 0: ICD-11
    str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P3) ~ 0,
    
    # Column 1: ICD-10, Ghosts, and Column 1 Orphans
    str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P2) | str_detect(name_str, "Ghost") | 
      (str_detect(name_str, "Only") & str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P3)) ~ 1,
    
    # Column 2: ICD-9, Final Bridges, and Column 2 Orphans
    str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P1) | str_detect(name_str, "Final") |
      (str_detect(name_str, "Only") & str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P2)) ~ 2,
    
    TRUE ~ 1
  )) %>%
  mutate(node_group = case_when(
    str_detect(name_str, "Ghost|Final") ~ "hide",
    str_detect(name_str, "Only")  ~ "Unique",
    level == 0 ~ "ICD11",
    level == 1 ~ "ICD10",
    level == 2 ~ "ICD9",
    TRUE ~ "Unique"
  ))

##Map IDs
processed_links$IDsource <- match(processed_links$src_label, nodes_group$name) - 1
processed_links$IDtarget <- match(processed_links$tgt_label, nodes_group$name) - 1

##Colors (Updated Domain for Reverse Order)
my_color_rev <- 'd3.scaleOrdinal() 
                 .domain(["ICD11", "ICD10", "ICD9", "Unique", "hide"]) 
                 .range(["#d98f21", "#085e9c", "#66a9d9", "#e03abf", "#cccccc"])'

##Create Sankey
# Dimensions modified for 14:7 ratio, margin flipped to allow right-flowing text to breathe
sn_group <- sankeyNetwork(
  Links = as.data.frame(processed_links), Nodes = as.data.frame(nodes_group),
  Source = "IDsource", Target = "IDtarget", Value = "value", NodeID = "name",
  NodeGroup = "node_group", colourScale = my_color_rev,
  nodePadding = 20, fontSize = 18, nodeWidth = 20, iterations = 0,
  sinksRight = TRUE, height = 700, width = 1200, margin = list(left = 1, right = 1)
)

##JavaScript Formatting (Includes 16pt font style, stroke halo, and phantom logic)
sn_group <- onRender(
  sn_group,
  'function(el, x) {
    d3.select(el).select("svg").style("overflow", "visible");
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node text")
      
      .style("font-family", "Arial, sans-serif")
      .style("font-size", "18pt")
      
      .attr("x", 25).attr("text-anchor", "start")
      .text(function(d) { 
          // Removes the version prefixes, then swaps the specific label
          return d.name.replace(/ICD-(9|10|11): /g, "")
                       .replace("ICD-10 Only", "Unique to ICD-10 and ICD-11 Only"); 
      });

    // Hide Final nodes
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node")
      .filter(function(d) { return d.name.indexOf("Final") > -1; })
      .style("opacity", 0).style("display", "none").style("pointer-events", "none");

    // Camouflage Ghosts (#cccccc)
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node rect")
      .filter(function(d) { return d.name.indexOf("Ghost") > -1; })
      .style("fill", "#cccccc").style("fill-opacity", 1).style("stroke-width", 0);

    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node text")
      .filter(function(d) { return d.name.indexOf("Ghost") > -1; })
      .style("display", "none");

    // Hide Structural Stretch Links
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".link")
      .filter(function(d) { 
        var targetName = typeof d.target === "object" ? d.target.name : x.nodes[d.target].name;
        return targetName.indexOf("Final") > -1; 
      })
      .style("stroke-opacity", 0).style("opacity", 0).style("pointer-events", "none");
  }'
)

#Final Output (Headers Swapped and Container Width matched)
browsable(
  tagList(
    tags$h2(paste("Reverse Mapping :", TARGET_GROUP), 
            style="text-align:center; font-family:Arial, sans-serif; color:#333;"),
    tags$div(
      style="display: flex; width: 1200px; margin: auto; font-weight: bold; font-family:Arial, sans-serif; text-align: center; font-size: 16pt;",
      tags$div(VERSION_P3, style="flex: 1;"),
      tags$div(VERSION_P2, style="flex: 1;"),
      tags$div(VERSION_P1, style="flex: 1;")
    ),
    tags$div(sn_group, style="display: flex; justify-content: center;")
  )
)


#Save the Sankey as a temporary HTML file
library(htmlwidgets)
library(webshot2)
saveWidget(sn_group, "temp_sankey.html", selfcontained = TRUE)

#Capture the HTML as a high-res PNG (1400x700 scaled by 6 = 8400x4200, achieving 600 DPI for 14"x7")
webshot("temp_sankey.html", 
        file = "C:/Users/mmvmk/Desktop/icd_r/outputs_sankeys/Aspergillus_ReverseSankey_Poster2.png", 
        delay = 2,      
        zoom = 6,       
        vwidth = 1200,  
        vheight = 700)
```


## 8.2 Blastomyces

### 8.2.1 Forward Best Matches

```{r}
########################################################################################################
#CREATE INDIVIDUAL DETAILED SANKEY NETWORK FOR EACH MAIN GROUP - BLASTOMYCES
########################################################################################################
##Specify main_group
TARGET_GROUP <- "Blastomyces"

##Get links for this group only
group_match_score <- match_score %>%
  filter(partner1_main_group == TARGET_GROUP & partner2_main_group == TARGET_GROUP)

l_9_10  <- allicd_bestmatch(group_match_score, VERSION_P1, VERSION_P2)
l_10_11 <- allicd_bestmatch(group_match_score, VERSION_P2, VERSION_P3)
l_9_11  <- allicd_bestmatch(group_match_score, VERSION_P1, VERSION_P3)

##Filter skip links (9 to 11) to avoid clutter
l_9_11_filtered <- l_9_11 %>% 
  left_join(l_9_10 %>% select(source_def, val_910 = value), by = "source_def") %>% 
  filter(is.na(val_910) | value > (val_910 + 10)) %>% select(-val_910)

##Capture Orphans
orph_9 <- clean_icd_data %>%
  filter(icd_version == VERSION_P1, main_group == TARGET_GROUP) %>% 
  anti_join(bind_rows(l_9_10, l_9_11_filtered), by = c("icd_definition" = "source_def")) %>%
  select(source_def = icd_definition) %>%
  mutate(target_def = paste0("Unique to ", VERSION_P1), value = 1)

orph_10 <- clean_icd_data %>%
  filter(icd_version == VERSION_P2, main_group == TARGET_GROUP) %>% 
  anti_join(l_10_11, by = c("icd_definition" = "source_def")) %>%
  select(source_def = icd_definition) %>%
  mutate(target_def = paste0("Unique to ", VERSION_P2), value = 1)

##Combine links
raw_links <- bind_rows(l_9_10, l_10_11, l_9_11_filtered, orph_9, orph_10)

##Build the Version Dictionary
version_dict <- clean_icd_data %>%
  filter(main_group == TARGET_GROUP) %>%
  select(icd_definition, icd_version) %>%
  distinct()

##Edit links so they contain icd_version as a prefix to assist with anchoring nodes
processed_links <- raw_links %>%
  left_join(version_dict, by = c("source_def" = "icd_definition")) %>%
  rename(src_v = icd_version) %>%
  left_join(version_dict, by = c("target_def" = "icd_definition")) %>%
  rename(tgt_v = icd_version) %>%
  mutate(
    #Ensure every source/target has a version assigned for column control
    src_v = case_when(
      !is.na(src_v) ~ src_v,
      grepl("ICD-9", source_def) ~ VERSION_P1,
      TRUE ~ VERSION_P1),
    tgt_v = case_when(
      !is.na(tgt_v) ~ tgt_v,
      grepl(VERSION_P2, target_def) ~ VERSION_P2,
      grepl(VERSION_P3, target_def) ~ VERSION_P3,
      #If it's unique to 9, it sits in the ICD-10 column
      grepl(paste0("Unique to ", VERSION_P1), target_def) ~ VERSION_P2,
      #If it's unique to 10, it sits in the ICD-11 column
      grepl(paste0("Unique to ", VERSION_P2), target_def) ~ VERSION_P3,
      TRUE ~ tgt_v
    ),
    #Create the final labels that will appear in the Sankey
    src_label = ifelse(grepl("Unique", source_def), source_def, paste0(src_v, ": ", source_def)),
    tgt_label = ifelse(grepl("Unique", target_def), target_def, paste0(tgt_v, ": ", target_def))
  ) %>%
  mutate(value = 1) # Force uniform thickness

##Define Nodes
nodes_group <- data.frame(name = unique(c(processed_links$src_label, processed_links$tgt_label)))

##Assign explicit levels (0, 1, 2) to force the columns for nodes
nodes_group <- nodes_group %>%
  mutate(level = case_when(
    grepl(VERSION_P1, name) ~ 0,
    grepl(VERSION_P2, name) ~ 1,
    grepl(VERSION_P3, name) ~ 2,
    TRUE ~ 1
  )) %>%
  #Define levels for nodes so I can add on specific colors for each icd_version column
  mutate(node_group = case_when(
    grepl("Unique", name) ~ "Unique",
    level == 0 ~ "ICD9",
    level == 1 ~ "ICD10",
    level == 2 ~ "ICD11",
    TRUE ~ "Unique"
  ))

##Map the source and target nodes
processed_links$IDsource <- match(processed_links$src_label, nodes_group$name) - 1
processed_links$IDtarget <- match(processed_links$tgt_label, nodes_group$name) - 1

##Specify colors
my_color <- 'd3.scaleOrdinal() 
             .domain(["ICD9", "ICD10", "ICD11", "Unique"]) 
             .range(["#66a9d9", "#085e9c", "#d98f21", "#e03abf"])'

##Create Sankey Network
sn_group <- sankeyNetwork(
  Links = as.data.frame(processed_links), 
  Nodes = as.data.frame(nodes_group),
  Source = "IDsource", Target = "IDtarget", 
  Value = "value", NodeID = "name", 
  NodeGroup = "node_group", colourScale = my_color,
  nodePadding = 10, fontSize = 14, nodeWidth = 30, 
  iterations = 0, sinksRight = TRUE,
  height = 235, width = 1500,
  margin = list(left = 475, right = 1)
)

#Format Text and add Headers and Title (Bold and Left-Align Column 0)
sn_group <- onRender(
  sn_group,
  'function(el, x) {
    d3.select(el).select("svg").style("overflow", "visible");
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node text")
      .style("font-weight", "bold")
      .style("font-family", "Arial, sans-serif")
      .style("font-size", "14px")
      .attr("x", 35) 
      .attr("text-anchor", "start").text(function(d) { 
          return d.name.replace(/ICD-(9|10|11): /g, "")
          .replace("ICD-10 Only", "Unique to ICD-10");
      });}  ')

browsable(
  tagList(
    tags$h2(paste("Forward Mapping:", TARGET_GROUP), 
            style="text-align:center; font-family:sans-serif; color:#333;"),
    tags$div(
      style="display: flex; width: 1500px; margin: auto; font-weight: bold; font-family:sans-serif; text-align: center;",
      tags$div(VERSION_P1, style="flex: 1;"),
      tags$div(VERSION_P2, style="flex: 1;"),
      tags$div(VERSION_P3, style="flex: 1;")
    ),
    tags$div(sn_group, style="display: flex; justify-content: center;")
  )
)




#Save the Sankey as a temporary HTML file
library(htmlwidgets)
library(webshot2)
saveWidget(sn_group, "temp_sankey.html", selfcontained = TRUE)

#Capture the HTML as a high-res PNG
webshot("temp_sankey.html", 
        file = "C:/Users/mmvmk/Desktop/icd_r/outputs_sankeys/Blastomyces_ForwardSankey.png", 
        delay = 2,      
        zoom = 3,       
        vwidth = 1500,  
        vheight = 800)

```

```{r}
raw_links <- bind_rows(l_9_10, l_10_11, l_9_11_filtered, orph_9, orph_10)

##Build the Version Dictionary
version_dict <- clean_icd_data %>%
  filter(main_group == TARGET_GROUP) %>%
  select(icd_definition, icd_version) %>%
  distinct()

##Edit links so they contain icd_version as a prefix to assist with anchoring nodes
processed_links <- raw_links %>%
  left_join(version_dict, by = c("source_def" = "icd_definition")) %>%
  rename(src_v = icd_version) %>%
  left_join(version_dict, by = c("target_def" = "icd_definition")) %>%
  rename(tgt_v = icd_version) %>%
  mutate(
    #Ensure every source/target has a version assigned for column control
    src_v = case_when(
      !is.na(src_v) ~ src_v,
      grepl("ICD-9", source_def) ~ VERSION_P1,
      TRUE ~ VERSION_P1),
    tgt_v = case_when(
      !is.na(tgt_v) ~ tgt_v,
      grepl(VERSION_P2, target_def) ~ VERSION_P2,
      grepl(VERSION_P3, target_def) ~ VERSION_P3,
      #If it's unique to 9, it sits in the ICD-10 column
      grepl(paste0("Unique to ", VERSION_P1), target_def) ~ VERSION_P2,
      #If it's unique to 10, it sits in the ICD-11 column
      grepl(paste0("Unique to ", VERSION_P2), target_def) ~ VERSION_P3,
      TRUE ~ tgt_v
    ),
    #Create the final labels that will appear in the Sankey
    src_label = ifelse(grepl("Unique", source_def), source_def, paste0(src_v, ": ", source_def)),
    tgt_label = ifelse(grepl("Unique", target_def), target_def, paste0(tgt_v, ": ", target_def))
  ) %>%
  mutate(value = 1) # Force uniform thickness

##Define Nodes
nodes_group <- data.frame(name = unique(c(processed_links$src_label, processed_links$tgt_label)))

##Assign explicit levels (0, 1, 2) to force the columns for nodes
nodes_group <- nodes_group %>%
  mutate(level = case_when(
    grepl(VERSION_P1, name) ~ 0,
    grepl(VERSION_P2, name) ~ 1,
    grepl(VERSION_P3, name) ~ 2,
    TRUE ~ 1
  )) %>%
  ##Define levels for nodes so I can add on specific colors for each icd_version column
  mutate(node_group = case_when(
    grepl("Unique", name) ~ "Unique",
    level == 0 ~ "ICD9",
    level == 1 ~ "ICD10",
    level == 2 ~ "ICD11",
    TRUE ~ "Unique"
  ))

##Map the source and target nodes
processed_links$IDsource <- match(processed_links$src_label, nodes_group$name) - 1
processed_links$IDtarget <- match(processed_links$tgt_label, nodes_group$name) - 1

##Specify colors
my_color <- 'd3.scaleOrdinal() 
             .domain(["ICD9", "ICD10", "ICD11", "Unique"]) 
             .range(["#66a9d9", "#085e9c", "#d98f21", "#e03abf"])'

##Create Sankey Network
sn_group <- sankeyNetwork(
  Links = as.data.frame(processed_links), 
  Nodes = as.data.frame(nodes_group),
  Source = "IDsource", Target = "IDtarget", 
  Value = "value", NodeID = "name", 
  NodeGroup = "node_group", colourScale = my_color,
  nodePadding = 10, fontSize = 14, nodeWidth = 30, 
  iterations = 0, sinksRight = TRUE,
  height = 520, width = 1500,
  margin = list(left = 475, right = 1)
)

#Format Text and add Headers and Title (Bold and Left-Align Column 0)
sn_group <- onRender(
  sn_group,
  'function(el, x) {
    d3.select(el).select("svg").style("overflow", "visible");
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node text")
      .style("font-weight", "bold")
      .style("font-family", "Arial, sans-serif")
      .style("font-size", "14px")
      .attr("x", 35) 
      .attr("text-anchor", "start").text(function(d) { 
          return d.name.replace(/ICD-(9|10|11): /g, "")
          .replace("ICD-10", "ICD-9 and ICD-10 or ICD-10 Only"); 
      });}  ')

browsable(
  tagList(
    tags$h2(paste("Forward Mapping:", TARGET_GROUP), 
            style="text-align:center; font-family:sans-serif; color:#333;"),
    tags$div(
      style="display: flex; width: 1500px; margin: auto; font-weight: bold; font-family:sans-serif; text-align: center;",
      tags$div(VERSION_P1, style="flex: 1;"),
      tags$div(VERSION_P2, style="flex: 1;"),
      tags$div(VERSION_P3, style="flex: 1;")
    ),
    tags$div(sn_group, style="display: flex; justify-content: center;")
  )
)




#Save the Sankey as a temporary HTML file
library(htmlwidgets)
library(webshot2)
saveWidget(sn_group, "temp_sankey.html", selfcontained = TRUE)

#Capture the HTML as a high-res PNG
webshot("temp_sankey.html", 
        file = "C:/Users/mmvmk/Desktop/icd_r/outputs_sankeys/Candida_ForwardSankey.png", 
        delay = 2,      
        zoom = 3,       
        vwidth = 1500,  
        vheight = 800)

```

### 8.3.2 Reverse Best Matches

```{r}
########################################################################################################
#CREATE INDIVIDUAL DETAILED SANKEY NETWORK FOR EACH MAIN GROUP - CANDIDA (REVERSE)
########################################################################################################
##Specify main_group
TARGET_GROUP <- "Candida"

##Get links for this group only
group_match_score <- match_score %>%
  filter(partner1_main_group == TARGET_GROUP & partner2_main_group == TARGET_GROUP)

#REVERSE Logic: source is the newer version, target is the older version
l_11_10 <- allicd_bestmatch(group_match_score, VERSION_P3, VERSION_P2)
l_10_9  <- allicd_bestmatch(group_match_score, VERSION_P2, VERSION_P1)
l_11_9  <- allicd_bestmatch(group_match_score, VERSION_P3, VERSION_P1)

##Filter skip links (11 to 9) to avoid clutter
l_11_9_filtered <- l_11_9 %>% 
  left_join(l_11_10 %>% select(source_def, val_1110 = value), by = "source_def") %>% 
  filter(is.na(val_1110) | value > (val_1110 + 10)) %>% select(-val_1110)

##Capture Orphans & Ghosts (Phantom Strategy - Reverse)
#Standard 11 to 10 Links
l_11_10_labeled <- l_11_10 %>%
  mutate(src_label = paste0(VERSION_P3, ": ", source_def),
         tgt_label = paste0(VERSION_P2, ": ", target_def))

#Standard 10 to 9 Links
l_10_9_labeled <- l_10_9 %>%
  mutate(src_label = paste0(VERSION_P2, ": ", source_def),
         tgt_label = paste0(VERSION_P1, ": ", target_def))

#Skip-Links (11 to Ghost to 9)
l_11_9_ghosts <- l_11_9_filtered %>%
  mutate(ghost_node = paste0("Ghost: ", source_def))

links_11_to_ghost <- l_11_9_ghosts %>%
  mutate(src_label = paste0(VERSION_P3, ": ", source_def),
         tgt_label = ghost_node) 

links_ghost_to_9 <- l_11_9_ghosts %>%
  mutate(src_label = ghost_node, 
         tgt_label = paste0(VERSION_P1, ": ", target_def))

#Orphans & Stretch Structural Links (Directional: 11 -> 10 column -> 9 column)
orph_11_to_10 <- clean_icd_data %>%
  filter(icd_version == VERSION_P3, main_group == TARGET_GROUP) %>% 
  anti_join(bind_rows(l_11_10, l_11_9_filtered), by = c("icd_definition" = "source_def")) %>%
  select(source_def = icd_definition) %>%
  mutate(target_def = paste0(VERSION_P3, " Only"), value = 1) %>%
  mutate(src_label = paste0(VERSION_P3, ": ", source_def),
         tgt_label = target_def)

orph_11_stretch <- orph_11_to_10 %>%
  select(source_def = target_def) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(target_def = paste0(VERSION_P3, " Only (Final)"), value = 1) %>%
  mutate(src_label = source_def, 
         tgt_label = target_def)

orph_10_to_9 <- clean_icd_data %>%
  filter(icd_version == VERSION_P2, main_group == TARGET_GROUP) %>% 
  anti_join(l_10_9, by = c("icd_definition" = "source_def")) %>%
  select(source_def = icd_definition) %>%
  mutate(target_def = paste0(VERSION_P2, " Only"), value = 1) %>%
  mutate(src_label = paste0(VERSION_P2, ": ", source_def),
         tgt_label = target_def)

##Combine all links
processed_links <- bind_rows(
  l_11_10_labeled, l_10_9_labeled, 
  links_11_to_ghost, links_ghost_to_9, 
  orph_11_to_10, orph_11_stretch, orph_10_to_9
) %>%
  mutate(value = 1)

##Define Nodes with Explicit Level Control
nodes_group <- data.frame(name = unique(c(processed_links$src_label, processed_links$tgt_label)))

nodes_group <- nodes_group %>%
  mutate(name_str = as.character(name)) %>% 
  mutate(level = case_when(
    #Column 0: ICD-11
    str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P3) ~ 0,
    
    #Column 1: ICD-10, Ghosts, and Column 1 Orphans
    str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P2) | str_detect(name_str, "Ghost") | 
      (str_detect(name_str, "Only") & str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P3)) ~ 1,
    
    #Column 2: ICD-9, Final Bridges, and Column 2 Orphans
    str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P1) | str_detect(name_str, "Final") |
      (str_detect(name_str, "Only") & str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P2)) ~ 2,
    
    TRUE ~ 1
  )) %>%
  mutate(node_group = case_when(
    str_detect(name_str, "Ghost|Final") ~ "hide",
    str_detect(name_str, "Only")  ~ "Unique",
    level == 0 ~ "ICD11",
    level == 1 ~ "ICD10",
    level == 2 ~ "ICD9",
    TRUE ~ "Unique"
  ))

##Map IDs
processed_links$IDsource <- match(processed_links$src_label, nodes_group$name) - 1
processed_links$IDtarget <- match(processed_links$tgt_label, nodes_group$name) - 1

##Colors (Updated Domain for Reverse Order)
my_color_rev <- 'd3.scaleOrdinal() 
                 .domain(["ICD11", "ICD10", "ICD9", "Unique", "hide"]) 
                 .range(["#d98f21", "#085e9c", "#66a9d9", "#e03abf", "#cccccc"])'

##Create Sankey
sn_group <- sankeyNetwork(
  Links = as.data.frame(processed_links), Nodes = as.data.frame(nodes_group),
  Source = "IDsource", Target = "IDtarget", Value = "value", NodeID = "name",
  NodeGroup = "node_group", colourScale = my_color_rev,
  nodePadding = 10, fontSize = 14, nodeWidth = 30, iterations = 0,
  sinksRight = TRUE, height = 730, width = 1500, margin = list(left = 475, right = 1)
)

##JavaScript Formatting (Includes font style and phantom logic)
sn_group <- onRender(
  sn_group,
  'function(el, x) {
    d3.select(el).select("svg").style("overflow", "visible");
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node text")
      .style("font-weight", "bold")
      .style("font-family", "Arial, sans-serif")
      .style("font-size", "14px")
      .attr("x", 35).attr("text-anchor", "start").text(function(d) { 
          return d.name.replace(/ICD-(9|10|11): /g, "")
          .replace("ICD-10 Only", "Unique to ICD-10 and ICD-11 or ICD-10 Only"); 
      });

    // Hide Final nodes
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node")
      .filter(function(d) { return d.name.indexOf("Final") > -1; })
      .style("opacity", 0).style("display", "none");

    // Camouflage Ghosts (#cccccc)
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node rect")
      .filter(function(d) { return d.name.indexOf("Ghost") > -1; })
      .style("fill", "#cccccc").style("fill-opacity", 1).style("stroke-width", 0);

    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node text")
      .filter(function(d) { return d.name.indexOf("Ghost") > -1; })
      .style("display", "none");

    // Hide Structural Stretch Links
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".link")
      .filter(function(d) { 
        var targetName = typeof d.target === "object" ? d.target.name : x.nodes[d.target].name;
        return targetName.indexOf("Final") > -1; 
      })
      .style("stroke-opacity", 0).style("opacity", 0).style("pointer-events", "none");
  }'
)

#Final Output (Headers Swapped)
browsable(
  tagList(
    tags$h2(paste("Reverse Mapping :", TARGET_GROUP), 
            style="text-align:center; font-family:Arial, sans-serif; color:#333;"),
    tags$div(
      style="display: flex; width: 1500px; margin: auto; font-weight: bold; font-family:Arial, sans-serif; text-align: center;",
      tags$div(VERSION_P3, style="flex: 1;"),
      tags$div(VERSION_P2, style="flex: 1;"),
      tags$div(VERSION_P1, style="flex: 1;")
    ),
    tags$div(sn_group, style="display: flex; justify-content: center;")
  )
)

#Save the Sankey as a temporary HTML file
library(htmlwidgets)
library(webshot2)
saveWidget(sn_group, "temp_sankey.html", selfcontained = TRUE)

#Capture the HTML as a high-res PNG
webshot("temp_sankey.html", 
        file = "C:/Users/mmvmk/Desktop/icd_r/outputs_sankeys/Candida_ReverseSankey.png", 
        delay = 2,      
        zoom = 3,       
        vwidth = 1500,  
        vheight = 900)


```

```{r}
#Standard 10 to 11 Links

  mutate(src_label = paste0(VERSION_P2, ": ", source_def),

#Skip-Links (9 to Ghost to 11)

links_9_to_ghost <- l_9_11_ghosts %>%

         tgt_label = ghost_node) 

links_ghost_to_11 <- l_9_11_ghosts %>%
  mutate(src_label = ghost_node, 
         tgt_label = paste0(VERSION_P3, ": ", target_def))

#Orphans & Stretch Structural Links
orph_9_to_10 <- clean_icd_data %>%
  filter(icd_version == VERSION_P1, main_group == TARGET_GROUP) %>% 
  anti_join(bind_rows(l_9_10, l_9_11_filtered), by = c("icd_definition" = "source_def")) %>%
  select(source_def = icd_definition) %>%
  mutate(target_def = paste0(VERSION_P1, " Only"), value = 1) %>%
  mutate(src_label = paste0(VERSION_P1, ": ", source_def),
         tgt_label = target_def)

orph_9_stretch <- orph_9_to_10 %>%

  mutate(target_def = paste0(VERSION_P1, " Only (Final)"), value = 1) %>%
  mutate(src_label = source_def, 
         tgt_label = target_def)

orph_10_to_11 <- clean_icd_data %>%
  filter(icd_version == VERSION_P2, main_group == TARGET_GROUP) %>% 
  anti_join(l_10_11, by = c("icd_definition" = "source_def")) %>%
  select(source_def = icd_definition) %>%
  mutate(target_def = paste0(VERSION_P2, " Only"), value = 1) %>%
  mutate(src_label = paste0(VERSION_P2, ": ", source_def),
         tgt_label = target_def)

##Combine all links
processed_links <- bind_rows(
  l_9_10_labeled, l_10_11_labeled, 
  links_9_to_ghost, links_ghost_to_11, 
  orph_9_to_10, orph_9_stretch, orph_10_to_11
) %>%
  mutate(value = 1)

##Define Nodes with Level control
nodes_group <- data.frame(name = unique(c(processed_links$src_label, processed_links$tgt_label)))

nodes_group <- nodes_group %>%
  mutate(name_str = as.character(name)) %>% 
  mutate(level = case_when(
    #Column 2: ICD-11, Final Bridge nodes, and ICD-10 Orphans
    str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P3) | str_detect(name_str, "Final") |
      (str_detect(name_str, "Only") & str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P2)) ~ 2,
    
    #Column 1: ICD-10, Ghost nodes, and ICD-9 Orphans
    str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P2) | str_detect(name_str, "Ghost") | 
      (str_detect(name_str, "Only") & str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P1)) ~ 1,
    
    #Column 0: ICD-9
    str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P1) ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ 1
  )) %>%
  mutate(node_group = case_when(
    str_detect(name_str, "Ghost|Final") ~ "hide",
    str_detect(name_str, "Only")  ~ "Unique",
    level == 0 ~ "ICD9",
    level == 1 ~ "ICD10",
    level == 2 ~ "ICD11",
    TRUE ~ "Unique"
  ))

##Map IDs
processed_links$IDsource <- match(processed_links$src_label, nodes_group$name) - 1
processed_links$IDtarget <- match(processed_links$tgt_label, nodes_group$name) - 1

##Create Sankey
sn_group <- sankeyNetwork(
  Links = as.data.frame(processed_links), Nodes = as.data.frame(nodes_group),
  Source = "IDsource", Target = "IDtarget", Value = "value", NodeID = "name",
  NodeGroup = "node_group", colourScale = my_color,
  nodePadding = 10, fontSize = 14, nodeWidth = 30, iterations = 0,
  sinksRight = TRUE, height = 310, width = 1500, margin = list(left = 475, right = 1)
)


##JavaScript to handle prefixes, phantom nodes, and camouflaged ghosts
sn_group <- onRender(
  sn_group,
  'function(el, x) {
    // 1. Label Formatting (Clean ICD-X prefixes visually)
    d3.select(el).select("svg").style("overflow", "visible");
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node text")
      .style("font-weight", "bold")
      .style("font-family", "Arial, sans-serif")
      .style("font-size", "14px")
      .attr("x", 35).attr("text-anchor", "start").text(function(d) { 
          return d.name.replace(/ICD-(9|10|11): /g, ""); 
      });

    // 2. Hide "Final" bridge nodes entirely
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node")
      .filter(function(d) { return d.name.indexOf("Final") > -1; })
      .style("opacity", 0).style("display", "none");

    // 3. CAMOUFLAGE the Ghost nodes (maintained #cccccc)
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node rect")
      .filter(function(d) { return d.name.indexOf("Ghost") > -1; })
      .style("fill", "#cccccc")
      .style("fill-opacity", 1)
      .style("stroke-width", 0);

    // 4. Hide labels for the Ghost nodes
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node text")
      .filter(function(d) { return d.name.indexOf("Ghost") > -1; })
      .style("display", "none");

    // 5. Hide the structural "Stretch" links
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".link")
      .filter(function(d) { 
        var targetName = typeof d.target === "object" ? d.target.name : x.nodes[d.target].name;
        return targetName.indexOf("Final") > -1; 
      })
      .style("stroke-opacity", 0).style("opacity", 0).style("pointer-events", "none");
  }'
)

browsable(
  tagList(
    tags$h2(paste("Forward Mapping :", TARGET_GROUP), 
            style="text-align:center; font-family:sans-serif; color:#333;"),
    tags$div(
      style="display: flex; width: 1500px; margin: auto; font-weight: bold; font-family:sans-serif; text-align: center;",
      tags$div(VERSION_P1, style="flex: 1;"),
      tags$div(VERSION_P2, style="flex: 1;"),
      tags$div(VERSION_P3, style="flex: 1;")
    ),
    tags$div(sn_group, style="display: flex; justify-content: center;")
  )
)
```

```{r}
         tgt_label = target_def)

orph_10_to_9 <- clean_icd_data %>%
  filter(icd_version == VERSION_P2, main_group == TARGET_GROUP) %>% 
  anti_join(l_10_9, by = c("icd_definition" = "source_def")) %>%
  select(source_def = icd_definition) %>%
  mutate(target_def = paste0(VERSION_P2, " Only"), value = 1) %>%
  mutate(src_label = paste0(VERSION_P2, ": ", source_def),
         tgt_label = target_def)

##Combine all links
processed_links <- bind_rows(
  l_11_10_labeled, l_10_9_labeled, 
  links_11_to_ghost, links_ghost_to_9, 
  orph_11_to_10, orph_11_stretch, orph_10_to_9
) %>%
  mutate(value = 1)

##Define Nodes with Explicit Level Control
nodes_group <- data.frame(name = unique(c(processed_links$src_label, processed_links$tgt_label)))

nodes_group <- nodes_group %>%
  mutate(name_str = as.character(name)) %>% 
  mutate(level = case_when(
    #Column 0: ICD-11
    str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P3) ~ 0,
    
    #Column 1: ICD-10, Ghosts, and Column 1 Orphans
    str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P2) | str_detect(name_str, "Ghost") | 
      (str_detect(name_str, "Only") & str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P3)) ~ 1,
    
    #Column 2: ICD-9, Final Bridges, and Column 2 Orphans
    str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P1) | str_detect(name_str, "Final") |
      (str_detect(name_str, "Only") & str_detect(name_str, VERSION_P2)) ~ 2,
    
    TRUE ~ 1
  )) %>%
  mutate(node_group = case_when(
    str_detect(name_str, "Ghost|Final") ~ "hide",
    str_detect(name_str, "Only")  ~ "Unique",
    level == 0 ~ "ICD11",
    level == 1 ~ "ICD10",
    level == 2 ~ "ICD9",
    TRUE ~ "Unique"
  ))

##Map IDs
processed_links$IDsource <- match(processed_links$src_label, nodes_group$name) - 1
processed_links$IDtarget <- match(processed_links$tgt_label, nodes_group$name) - 1

##Colors (Updated Domain for Reverse Order)
my_color_rev <- 'd3.scaleOrdinal() 
                 .domain(["ICD11", "ICD10", "ICD9", "Unique", "hide"]) 
                 .range(["#d98f21", "#085e9c", "#66a9d9", "#e03abf", "#cccccc"])'

##Create Sankey
sn_group <- sankeyNetwork(
  Links = as.data.frame(processed_links), Nodes = as.data.frame(nodes_group),
  Source = "IDsource", Target = "IDtarget", Value = "value", NodeID = "name",
  NodeGroup = "node_group", colourScale = my_color_rev,
  nodePadding = 10, fontSize = 14, nodeWidth = 30, iterations = 0,
  sinksRight = TRUE, height = 355, width = 1500, margin = list(left = 475, right = 1)
)

##JavaScript Formatting (Includes font style and phantom logic)
sn_group <- onRender(
  sn_group,
  'function(el, x) {
    d3.select(el).select("svg").style("overflow", "visible");
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node text")
      .style("font-weight", "bold")
      .style("font-family", "Arial, sans-serif")
      .style("font-size", "14px")
      .attr("x", 35).attr("text-anchor", "start").text(function(d) { 
          return d.name.replace(/ICD-(9|10|11): /g, "")
          .replace("ICD-10 Only", "Unique to ICD-10 and ICD-11 or ICD-10 Only"); 
      });

    // Hide Final nodes
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node")
      .filter(function(d) { return d.name.indexOf("Final") > -1; })
      .style("opacity", 0).style("display", "none");

    // Camouflage Ghosts (#cccccc)
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node rect")
      .filter(function(d) { return d.name.indexOf("Ghost") > -1; })
      .style("fill", "#cccccc").style("fill-opacity", 1).style("stroke-width", 0);

    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node text")
      .filter(function(d) { return d.name.indexOf("Ghost") > -1; })
      .style("display", "none");

    // Hide Structural Stretch Links
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".link")
      .filter(function(d) { 
        var targetName = typeof d.target === "object" ? d.target.name : x.nodes[d.target].name;
        return targetName.indexOf("Final") > -1; 
      })
      .style("stroke-opacity", 0).style("opacity", 0).style("pointer-events", "none");
  }'
)

#Final Output (Headers Swapped)
browsable(
  tagList(
    tags$h2(paste("Reverse Mapping :", TARGET_GROUP), 
            style="text-align:center; font-family:Arial, sans-serif; color:#333;"),
    tags$div(
      style="display: flex; width: 1000px; margin: auto; font-weight: bold; font-family:Arial, sans-serif; text-align: center;",
      tags$div(VERSION_P3, style="flex: 1;"),
      tags$div(VERSION_P2, style="flex: 1;"),
      tags$div(VERSION_P1, style="flex: 1;")
    ),
    tags$div(sn_group, style="display: flex; justify-content: center;")
  )
)

#Save the Sankey as a temporary HTML file
library(htmlwidgets)
library(webshot2)
saveWidget(sn_group, "temp_sankey.html", selfcontained = TRUE)

#Capture the HTML as a high-res PNG
webshot("temp_sankey.html", 
        file = "C:/Users/mmvmk/Desktop/icd_r/outputs_sankeys/Coccidioides_ReverseSankey.png", 
        delay = 2,      
        zoom = 3,       
        vwidth = 1500,  
        vheight = 900)
```
